fields.label: Description
fields.value: This poster which was printed by the United Farm Workers features artwork titled, ""Claudia"" by Rafael Escamilla R. Although this is a reproduction printed on glossy poster paper, the original piece was created with pencil on an illustration board. The foreground of the artwork features a young child with brown hair that is tied into a ponytail wearing brown pants and wrapped in a white shawl with light red stripes and light blue fringe. The top two quarters of the background is dedicated to a light blue sky scattered with clouds and includes the text, ""AMERICAS 2001"" at the top. The bottom third of the piece features rolling hills with trees, bodies of water, animals, farmland, farm workers along with a small city or town in the distance. On the bottom left of the piece there is a small Aztec eagle which is used as the United Farm Workers logo along with the text reading, ""Printing courtesy of the United Farm Workers." On the bottom right of the piece there is text which reads, ""CLAUDIA. Rafael Escamilla R. Lapiz sobre carton/pencil on illust. board. 39"" x 40"".
